digest.component_or_area: store write path (event creation and batch operations)
propositions: Directory is created outside the write lock but its first event file lands only after lock acquisition, creating a window where an interruption leaves an empty ticket directory that fsck reports as MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH

The problem affects both single-event stage_and_commit and batch_stage_and_commit since they share _prepare_event, and also occurs in inbound_translate._write_event_file and dispatch_one BRIDGE_ALERT emission

Solution stages the directory and first event atomically in a dot-prefixed staging directory, then publishes with a single os.rename under the write lock, making temp paths invisible to fsck scanners without code changes

Stale staging directories from dead processes are swept at writer start using process owner stamps (host+pid-namespace+start-time) to prevent pid recycling attacks, bounded as best-effort without violating the bug-043f boundary that rejects automatic cleanup of store data
Concurrent creates of different tickets produce distinct staging names using pid and uuid4 suffixes, preserving existing write-lock discipline and concurrency semantics

All six acceptance criteria are met: atomic publication with no fsck-visible debris, RED-to-GREEN test reproduction, unchanged concurrency, all same-signature sites audited and converted or exempted with reasons, linting and type-checking clean, and event format and layout unchanged
